_comment: INSTALLED into user-level ~/.zcode/cli/config.json on 2026-09-28 with user approval (backup: config.json.bak-hooks-20260928). This file remains the reference copy of what was installed.
_verified_facts: Location per https://zcode.z.ai/en/docs/hooks: executed hooks live in ~/.zcode/cli/config.json (or an installed plugin's hooks/hooks.json); the file must set hooks.enabled=true, and event arrays nest under hooks.events.

PostToolUse input is one line of JSON on the hook's stdin carrying tool_input, tool_name, tool_use_id and tool_response; the edited file arrives as tool_input.file_path. ZCode injects no environment variable with edited-file paths (only ZCODE_PLUGIN_ROOT/_DATA/_ID/_NAME), so the command must read stdin.
timeoutMs is milliseconds and overrides the legacy seconds-based timeout.

hooks.command: uv run python -c "import json,sys,subprocess; d=json.load(sys.stdin); p=(d.get('tool_input') or {}).get('file_path',''); sys.exit(subprocess.run(['uv','run','ruff','check',p]).returncode) if p.endswith('.py') else None"
